title: Michael J NDE 9814
content: I was drinking vodka straight out of the bottle. I had drank so much in such a short period of time, I must of died from alcohol poisoning. Everything was fine at first. I came home, went to the bathroom and passed out. I was looking around and I recognized I was my apartment but it was all dark. I started flying, like drifting around my apartment wondering what’s going on and why is so dark? Then I realized I hovering over my body. All of a sudden, I heard whispering voices coming from out of no where saying, 'He can't see him' and 'Don’t let him see himself.' Naturally, I went back into the bathroom to see what they were talking about. I saw my body crouched around the toilet. Then, I felt sucked backed into my body. I woke up and started throwing up like crazy. I crawled back to my room and went to sleep. When I awoke again, I knew that I had an experience that wasn't a dream. It was way to vivid and I will never forget that experience. environment.environment_other_detail: His apartment was perceived as "all dark" / "complete darkness" though it was daytime, yet furnishings were visible.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Alcohol poisoning from drinking large amounts of vodka quickly (possible overdose).

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Stated "No comment" for religion prior and now.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Whispering voices: "He can't see him" / "Don’t let him see himself." Darkness overlaying familiar apartment despite daytime.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in darkened apartment, then hovering over body and hearing voices, then abrupt return ("sucked back").

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred in a familiar setting (his apartment) perceived as completely dark though it was daytime; disembodied whispering voices focused on preventing him from seeing his body/self.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "He can't see him"; "Don’t let him see himself."; "I felt sucked backed into my body."; "It felt more real then anything."
